name: Yaegaki Erika
source:
A strange, asocial girl.
She talks like a man, but this is her way of building a wall between herself and others.
Generally she likes to be by herself, though she will speak to others to tease them. Her whimsical cat-like character makes her elusive.
What part will she play in the tale… She is known as the girl in the wheelchair.
Unable to move her legs due to illness, she lives her life in a wheelchair.
Her interests are reading and finding people’s weak points.

[From [url=http://flowersgame.com/]Jast USA[/url]]
